answer: A genesis tax makes each fake pay up front: newcomers pay 90 units, never refunded, with a 4-epoch observation window. A trellis of audit trails links each payment to one credential; proven fraud burns the remaining tax, freezes the identity 8 epochs, and repeat abuse hits a zenith ban. Forging 1,000 identities costs 90,000 units; with 30% caught the attacker loses 27,000, while the knoll of honest history keeps real users cheap.
